newsitem.title: CHILE: Tremor hits ski center in Chilean capital.
newsitem.headline: Tremor hits ski center in Chilean capital.

text.p: The Chilean capital of Santiago was shaken on Thursday morning by a 40-second tremor measuring 5.1 degrees on the Richter scale, although no damages were initially reported.
The rough movement was felt at 8:22 a.m. (1222 GMT), with its epicentre in the ski centre of Farallones, east of Santiago, according to Chile's National Emergency Bureau.
Albertu Maturana, head of the bureau, called on the population to refrain from going to Farallones, a snow covered resort town in the Andes mountain range, due to the danger of landslides.
He added that no damages had been reported, and telephone and electric connections remained in service throughout Santiago.
